verdict.rationale: Origin-country guidance is a fair question for an immigration-services provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only visa-category pages (H-1B, O-1, TN, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW), fee calculators and general blogs. It contains nothing on consulate processing, country-specific backlogs, or pages for founders from particular countries. The TN page discusses role-category fit, not nationality-specific guidance.
